info.name: Bite API
info.description: Postman collection for Bite API (AI endpoints) with basic tests

exec: pm.test('Response has success true', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.success).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('Response has dishName and confidence', function () { var d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d).to.have.property('dishName'); pm.expect(d).to.have.property('confidence'); pm.expect(pm.typeOf(d.dishName)).to.eql('string'); pm.expect(pm.typeOf(d.confidence)).to.eql('number'); });

pm.test('Response success true and recipe present', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(json.data).to.have.property('recipeName'); pm.expect(json.data).to.have.property('ingredients'); pm.expect(json.data).to.have.property('instructions'); pm.expect(Array.isArray(json.data.ingredients)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(Array.isArray(json.data.instructions)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(json.data.ingredients.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(json.data.instructions.length).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test('Response success true', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.success).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('Data contains recipes array', function () { var d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d).to.have.property('recipes'); pm.expect(Array.isArray(d.recipes)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d).to.have.property('searchTerm'); pm.expect(typeof d.searchTerm).to.eql('string'); });
